scope: Bounded search. A timed-out case is UNKNOWN, never a negative. No hit is a non-existence proof, and a hit needs the oriented whole-link checks of research/20 before it is called a counterexample. This file records ONE interrupted case and is retained as a preserved attempt, not as coverage: it is not a negative result.
why_superseded: The 420s cap bought a longer prefix of an enumeration that cannot finish at this size: the repository's own probes (teichner_D01_J946_probe.json, teichner_D01_J941_probe.json) return TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN on the same 2-band, length-6 box over a 34-crossing sum, at ~6500 bands in 180s. The K_B calibration found its ribbon disk on the first diagram in 0.9 seconds, so in this box a hit arrives fast or not at all. Budget was therefore moved to many short cases (120s) over many diagrams rather than few long ones.
